The journalist must be to the right of the adventure‑watcher, so with only two positions the journalist is in position 2 and the adventure‑watcher in position 1.  
The police‑officer cannot be the same person as the filmmaking hobbyist, so the filmmaking hobbyist must be the journalist (the only other job). Thus position 2 (journalist) has hobby filmmaking, and position 1 has the remaining hobby collecting and the remaining job police‑officer.  
The adventure‑watcher is position 1, and the thriller‑watcher is position 2.

<solution>1, filmmaking, police-officer, journalist</solution>
Final answer: 1, filmmaking, police-officer, journalist
